implementation_audit.method: Read-only checkpoint EDIF extraction using installed Vivado libzstd; no Vivado run
implementation_audit.scope: Same exact leakage candidate before/after input pipelining; different latency, fixture and constraints, so resource causes only, not a matched timing or throughput comparison

route_row.scope: registered OOC timing fixture; not a production interface or board measurement

inference.explanation: 33 raw capture +22 metadata +4 output copies +6 control =151−86. At positive constant coefficient, bypass implies zero raw input; explicitly exposing that invariant can remove unused metadata and sign copies. This is an optimization hypothesis, not a measured repaired-core saving.
inference.carry_explanation: 18 versus14 CARRY4; name-derived pre-correction chains12 versus8, consistent with two extra seven-bit narrow subtraction chains. Naming is structural evidence rather than a formal cell-to-expression proof.

limitations: No new synthesis or route.
Registers outside the core are excluded by preserved fixture register names.
Constant bypass removal and subtraction sharing need separate exact RTL/routing verification.
The four-stage worst routed path is an input bypass/enable path, so correction sharing alone does not imply a timing benefit.

whole_product_numerical_screen.scope: CW0 wide-pair packing algebra only; no RTL simulation or hardware measurement

contract.oracle: ceil((256-delta)*U/256), computed by signed mathematical ceiling division
contract.c_field: 256*(128+delta*h), encoded by inversion of signed-eight-bit product sign

rows.test: arbitrary stale DSP words under bypass

exhaustive_bound_proof.reasoning: Each independent field fits unsigned16, so low-lane product plus C cannot carry into the next lane; upper field cannot carry into bit32.

limitations: Packing algebra matches pinned source expressions but does not execute HDL.
Narrow triple and CW1 centered arithmetic retain earlier methods and are outside this new whole-product proof.
Pipeline stalls/reset/order and all engine outputs require the separate RTL suites.

definitions.changing_operation: U != ceil(231*U/256); positive U=0..10 are exact fixed points.
definitions.issued_dsp: accepted request whose bypass is false; counted from the exact core policy, not from toggle instrumentation.
definitions.dsp_lanes: E0/E6 narrow:3 otherwise first2; E1:first2; E4:3; E5:first2, third is separate LUT.
definitions.capacity_denominator: Sum of physical 2/3 lane capacity over issued requests, including unused tail slots and zero/unchanged valid lanes.
definitions.nonzero: Input membrane U is nonzero. It may still remain numerically unchanged.
definitions.bypass: No DSP issue when delta=0 or the available raw window is all zero; these traces use delta25.
definitions.identity_pair_policy: Three only for fixed triple/hybrid, an eligible narrow triple, or a real zero third lane.
definitions.clock_utilization: Not reported: this audit is useful operations per issued DSP and per issued lane capacity.

limitations: Numerical schedule accounting, not measured toggles, energy, power, DSP utilization over clock time, host latency, or full neuron-update latency.
Uses saved beta231 model traces without retraining; these differ from the models original trained leakage parameters.
Hybrid LUT third-lane operations are excluded from DSP usefulness and listed separately.
Schedule counts are crosschecked against completed original delta25 primitive simulations; WHOLE arithmetic verification is a separate gate.
CW0/CW1 use the same policy and traces, so the accounting applies to both encodings.

independent_trace_accounting_audit.scope: Independent beta231 numerical issue/lane recount; no toggle or hardware utilization measurement
findings: All reported issue/numerator/capacity counts and quoted ratios independently match.
Zero-third-copy and LUT-third totals include bypass windows. They overlap bypassed-neuron totals, so those reported categories must not be added as disjoint counts.
The extra rows here split active and bypass extra lanes; DSP valid operations + bypassed neurons + active extra lanes exactly equals real neurons.
Completed WHOLE CW0 model/stress RTL schedules independently match the accounting.
Changing is numerical U differs from exact ceiling-leaked U. Nonzero and numerical changing work are distinct; neither is measured DSP-clock utilization.
Hybrid DSP usefulness excludes its separate LUT-third work and cannot alone determine total core throughput.

limitations: Leakage primitive only. Current integration, threshold/reset, state and classification comparisons are reconstructed in Python.

Three raw lookahead values and up to three results per clock require corresponding state-memory bandwidth. No state RAM, bank rotation, pointer update, lookahead cache or three-read/write interface is routed.
Shared delta0..31 per request, signed int11 U. The policy is not validated for arbitrary coefficients, arbitrary widths or other neuron dynamics.
The registered fixture contributes exactly 83 FFs outside the reported core. It samples input/output unconditionally and is not a production handshake wrapper.
Occupied slices are shared between core and fixture. Core touched slices are nonadditive and alone do not establish an area win.
Hierarchy preservation constrains optimization across fixture/core boundaries. All candidates share the same rule.

Vivado OOC original/strong targets are6ns. Final whole-product constant targets are6ns, programmable targets8ns, with HD.CLK_SRC BUFGCTRL_X0Y0. Primary comparisons stay within each coefficient cohort. Cross-target resource/cycle comparisons are labeled diagnostics. No Fmax, board latency, power or energy is certified.
The beta231 reference changes the saved models original leakage. No retraining was performed. Only 144 images, the first48 of each seed, receive this RTL replay.
Programmable hardware comparisons reuse the delta25 model schedule; they are not evaluations of a different programmable-coefficient SNN.
Arithmetic issues count non-bypassed kernel requests for every engine, including LUT-only engines. They do not prove all DSP lanes contain changing useful work.
For delta25 U in[0,10] is unchanged by leakage. An extra identity-aware monitor is an analytic opportunity, not an implemented/routed improvement.
Synthetic burst replay does not establish a natural-model burst latency win or worst-case guarantee.
No FireFly RTL or accelerator measurement was reproduced. LUT3 is our matched scalar-leakage reference, not FireFly.
Novelty remains unproved. Generic DSP packing and correction are established; this trial measures an actual-membrane-driven exact leakage policy.
